description_expanded: AboutVilla Del Mar | Seagrove Beach Vacation Rental with Golf Cart, Hot Tub, Bikes and Walkable Beach Access on 30A Welcome to Villa Del Mar, a luxury Seagrove Beach vacation rental on 30A located in the gated community of Palmeira Villas. This beautifully designed 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom vacation home comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests and offers the perfect combination of luxury amenities, coastal charm, and an unbeatable location near Seaside, Eastern Lake, and the sugar-white beaches of South Walton. Whether you're planning a family beach vacation, a couples getaway, a girls' trip, or a multi-family retreat, Villa Del Mar places you in the heart of everything that makes 30A one of Florida's most sought-after vacation destinations. Spend your days relaxing on the beach, cruising Scenic Highway 30A in the complimentary golf cart, biking to Seaside, exploring coastal dune lakes, enjoying boutique shopping, and dining at some of the area's most popular restaurants. What Guests Love About Villa Del Mar • Complimentary 6-passenger street-legal golf cart • Four complimentary bikes • Four backpack beach chairs • Beach umbrella • Beach wagon • Beach towels provided • Private hot tub • Outdoor firepit • Outdoor grill • Games and books for family entertainment • Fully equipped kitchen • Complimentary spices • Smart TVs in every bedroom • Walk, bike, or ride the golf cart to Seaside • Short walk to beach access • Gated Seagrove Beach community • Close to restaurants, shopping, coffee shops, and entertainment • Beverage station with mini bar, beverage refrigerator, and Keurig coffee maker • Multiple private balconies • Full-size washer and dryer • Prime Seagrove Beach Location Villa Del Mar is ideally situated in Seagrove Beach along Scenic Highway 30A, offering convenient access to some of the Emerald Coast's most popular attractions. Nearby attractions include: • Seaside • Eastern Lake • Point Washington State Forest • Scenic 30A bike path • Public beach access • Boutique shopping • Local seafood restaurants • Coffee shops • Coastal dune lakes • Family-friendly attractions Leave the car parked and explore the area by golf cart, bike, or on foot. First Floor | Open Concept Living and Entertaining The first floor features a spacious open-concept layout designed for gathering and entertaining. The comfortable living room offers ample seating for family movie nights, game days, and relaxing after a day at the beach. Coastal-inspired décor creates a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout the home. The fully equipped kitchen is designed for everything from quick breakfasts to holiday meals and includes: • Stainless steel appliances • Gas range • Ample counter space • Breakfast bar seating • Cookware and serving pieces • Complimentary spices • Coffee station The adjacent dining area provides plenty of room for family meals and conversation. A full bathroom is also conveniently located on the first floor. Outdoor Living Space After a day enjoying Seagrove Beach and 30A, retreat to your private outdoor oasis. Enjoy: • Private hot tub • Outdoor firepit • Gas grill • Comfortable outdoor seating • Space for gathering with family and friends Spend your evenings grilling fresh Gulf seafood, soaking in the hot tub, and enjoying the peaceful coastal atmosphere. Second Floor | Comfortable Accommodations for Family and Friends Primary King Suite • King bed • Smart TV • Private balcony • Ensuite bathroom King Guest Bedroom • King bed • Smart TV • Private balcony Bunk Bedroom • Full-over-full bunk bed • Twin pullout trundle • Smart TV The King Guest Bedroom and Bunk Bedroom share a convenient Jack-and-Jill bathroom, making this floor ideal for families traveling together. Additional second-floor amenities include: • Convenient laundry room equipped with a full-size washer and dryer Third Floor | Private Primary Retreat The entire third floor serves as a luxurious private retreat. Primary King Suite • King bed • Smart TV • Private balcony • Ensuite bathroom • Soaking tub • Separate walk-in shower Just outside the suite, guests will enjoy a dedicated beverage station featuring: • Mini bar • Beverage refrigerator • Keurig coffee machine Enjoy morning coffee on the balcony before heading to the beach or unwind with an evening beverage after a day of exploring 30A. Beach Days Made Easy At FunVacay, we believe your vacation should be as effortless as possible. Villa Del Mar includes: • Beach towels • Backpack beach chairs • Beach umbrella • Beach wagon • Bikes • Golf cart Everything you need for memorable days on the beautiful beaches of South Walton. Included with Every FunVacay Stay • Beach Towels (Minimum of 4 Provided) • Backpack Beach Chairs (Minimum of 4 Provided) • Spices • Starter Amenities • Complimentary Pack of Starbucks Coffee • Bottled Water Upon Arrival • Access to Pack 'n Play and Highchair Upon Request Pack Less. Vacation More. Book your stay at Villa Del Mar and discover why families return year after year to experience the best of Seagrove Beach, Scenic Highway 30A, Seaside, Eastern Lake, and Florida's Emerald Coast with FunVacay Luxury Rentals.
